correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the three-hub separation inclusion-exclusion: R=(1-q)^n [(1+q+q²)^n -3(q+2q²)^n+2(3q²)^n]. The three events and their overlap are exhaustive after every degree-three vertex retains an edge. With A=1+q+q², B=q(1+2q), C=3q², exact identity A+2C-3B=(q-1)² plus convexity yields F>0 for B>=0 and q!=1. For -1/2<q<0, the parity argument and 1-4x+7x²>0 establish positivity for both parities. F(1)=F'(1)=0, F''(1)=6n²3^(n-2)>0, and leading coefficient 1-3*2^n+2*3^n>0 for n>=2 establish precisely n+2 copies of q=1 and 2n-2 nonreal roots. Independent edge-mask connectivity enumeration reproduced the formula for n=2,3,4; all-real n bound rests on the inequalities, not enumeration.
